Kahaani Play-Ground

A Text-Based Theatre Workshop
Parwana Theatre
Theatre | Workshop

Oct

04

2026
09:30 am - 01:30 pm

An intensive one-day workshop inviting actors, writers, directors, or anyone interested in theatre-making to peel back, interpret, and (re)imagine the many layers of a theatrical text — bringing those discoveries into performance. Through readings, textual analysis, explorations of space, improvisations, and scene work, participants will encounter skills from the performing arts which they can utilize in their personal, professional, and creative lives.
